title: Best AI Website Builder for Nonprofits in 2026
summary: We scored eight AI website builders on the eight things that matter to a nonprofit running on a volunteer budget: a real donation flow, volunteer sign-up, and a cost that doesn't eat into the mission.
body_markdown: Yes, with the right tool. Blink writes both into a real, managed database the org can see and export directly, without a separate CRM subscription. Most template-driven builders treat these as basic form submissions that land in an inbox instead.
